=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25296 (merged-guard fallback: if _resolve_issue_implementation_pr "${issue_num}"; then) versus 25976-25986 (attempt_merge branch: elif _resolve_issue_implementation_pr "${issue_num}"; then) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The ai:ready-to-merge resolver fallback at 25292-25308 stores only success values (25304-25307). When the resolver returns 1, the prefetch variables stay empty and the guards fail open. The attempt_merge branch at 25976 then calls _resolve_issue_implementation_pr a second time, repeating _linked_prs_by_branch_name (23196), _issue_cross_ref_pr_numbers_unique (23215) and the pulls/<n> fetches (23199/23218). Because 23188 resets STALL_IMPL_PR_FAILURE_REASON, the first call's failure reason is lost.
  WHY: Every unresolvable standalone ai:ready-to-merge candidate pays the discovery cost twice per tick with no change in outcome, which contradicts the changelog's "no extra API call" claim. Suggested fix: set a per-candidate flag next to the resets at 24936-24937 and reuse STALL_IMPL_PR_NUM / STALL_IMPL_PR_JSON / STALL_IMPL_PR_FAILURE_REASON in attempt_merge.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21772-21776 (invoke_stall_judge, merged-state derivation) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: pr_state is forced to "merged" when .merged is true OR when merged_at is non-empty. A payload with merged=false and a merged_at value would be reported as merged, and the escalation guard at 22139-22141 would then keep escalate_human.
  WHY: This is defensive only, because GitHub's REST payload keeps the two fields consistent. Suggested fix: `if [ "${pr_merged}" = "true" ] || { [ -z "${pr_merged}" ] && [ -n "${pr_merged_at}" ]; }; then` (estimated 2 lines changed).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
